item.title: Ikea drabbat i stor it-attack – ville stjäla krypto

item.summary: On 16 November 2026, malicious JavaScript was served through Optimizely Web Experimentation to visitors of websites at about 178 organisations, including IKEA, according to Report URI and security researcher Scott Helme. The code swapped cryptocurrency wallet addresses and skimmed payment cards, among other things. Report URI said about USD 7,040 had reached the attackers' wallets by 19:25 UTC on 16 November.
